stand: End play on the current hand without taking another card.
double: Double the wager, take exactly one card, then stand.
split: Separate a matching pair into two independently played hands.
surrender: Give up the hand and lose half of its wager when the rules allow it.
hardHand: A hand with no ace currently counted as 11.
softHand: A hand containing an ace currently counted as 11.
runningCount: The cumulative total of the Hi-Lo tags of every exposed card.
trueCount: Running count divided by the estimated decks remaining.
penetration: The percentage of a shoe dealt before the shuffle card is reached.
